Corollary
[Area preservation under normalized flow] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0122 1. Corollary 5.6\group evolution-equations-on-surfaces

If $(\mathcal{M}^n,g(t))$ is a solution of the normalized Ricci flow \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}g=(r-R)g, \] then the total volume $\Vol (\mathcal M^n,g(t))$ is constant in time.
